title: Budget alert threshold
pr_description: Adds budget_alerts() which flags every category whose spend has reached a configurable percentage of its monthly budget (default 80%), so the UI can warn users before they go over.

defects.description: Integer floor division runs before the multiply, so pct is 0 for any spend below the limit and alerts only fire once the budget is already blown. Should be spent * 100 // limit_cents.
The docstring and default promise alerts when spend has *reached* the threshold, but the strict > excludes exactly-80% spend. Should be >=.
